work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLXIV congratulates Emperor Ferdinand on the birth of a son to Archduke Francis Charles; address, intitulation, body and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF31561–31561; the source dating clause at LF31609–31612 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima iunii millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
